title: Epimorphic and monomorphic projections of an abelian pullback
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with pullbacks. For morphisms $p:x\to y$ and $f:n\to y$, let $t=x\times_y n$ be their pullback, with projections $a:t\to x$ and $b:t\to n$, so $pa=fb$. If $p$ is an epimorphism, then $b$ is an epimorphism. If $f$ is a monomorphism, then $a$ is a monomorphism.
